name: Accounting
description: Answers requests for financial reports, such as open invoices, aged balances, a trial balance or a customer's ledger, from the Odoo books, which it only reads.

skills.name: Accounting
skills.description: Answers requests for financial reports, such as open invoices, aged balances, a trial balance or a customer's ledger, from the Odoo books, which it only reads.
examples: List the customer invoices that are still open, with the total due.
Give the aged receivables as of today, by customer.
Give the trial balance for last month.

extensions.description: Pause at a checkpoint and resume from it; steer a task while it works.
Its face: an emoji, and an avatar when it has one.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: A Datalayer key granted to this route: a token exchanged from a task grant whose task is this application's route on this runtime. The machine itself needs none.
